decisions.reason: Visibility rose from a mention to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and keeping a core safety shoe line costs little given in-house production.
The comfort insole is still only mentioned and its value remains uncertain, but an insole is a cheap accessory that complements the shoe portfolio, so the option is worth keeping open.
The supportive insole has stayed at low visibility, but its carrying cost is minimal and it supports the firm's tailored-solution positioning, so abandoning it is not yet justified.
The ergonomic series has had its own page in both years, showing sustained commitment and alignment with the firm's innovation focus on evolving workplace needs.
The firefighter boots were upgraded to a dedicated page, which suggests the uncertainty is resolving favourably in a specialised segment that fits the firm's protective expertise.
The moulded FIT insole is featured on the home page with a concrete reference customer and ties into the foot-measurement services, so its value is being realized.
